question: In which Indian state is Onam celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Onam** is an annual harvest festival celebrated predominantly in the Indian state of **Kerala**, marking the homecoming of King Mahabali.
 
• It is observed during the **Malayalam month of Chingam**, which usually falls in **August–September**.
 
• Onam is a celebration that includes **traditional feasts** (called Onasadya), **Pookkalam** (floral decorations), **Vallam Kali** (boat races), **Pulikali** (tiger dances), and **Kathakali performances**.
 
• The festival is deeply rooted in Kerala’s culture and is celebrated by people of all religions, showcasing unity and harmony.
 
• Onam has been officially recognized as the **state festival of Kerala** due to its historical, cultural, and social significance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Historical Background of Onam:**

 
 
• According to legend, Onam is celebrated to honor the **benevolent King Mahabali**, who ruled Kerala and was known for his generosity, fairness, and prosperity.
 
• It is believed that the **Vamana avatar** of Lord Vishnu sent King Mahabali to the netherworld, but granted him permission to visit his people once a year, which is celebrated as Onam.
 
 
 
• **Onasadya:**
 
 
• Onasadya is a grand feast served on a banana leaf and consists of approximately **26 traditional dishes**, including rice, sambar, avial, thoran, and payasam.
 
• This feast is an integral part of the celebration and reflects Kerala’s culinary heritage.
 
 
 
• **Vallam Kali (Boat Race):**
 
 
• Vallam Kali is a traditional snake boat race held during Onam, with the **Nehru Trophy Boat Race** being the most famous.
 
• It showcases Kerala’s maritime traditions and involves synchronized rowing by hundreds of participants.
 
 
 
• **Pookkalam:**
 
 
• Pookkalam refers to the intricate floral designs made on the ground using colorful flowers to welcome King Mahabali.
 
• These designs symbolize prosperity and are created by families and communities during the festival.
 
 
 
• **Unity in Diversity:**
 
 
• Onam is celebrated by people of all religions and communities in Kerala, highlighting the state’s **diverse and inclusive culture**.
 
• It serves as a platform for cultural expression and communal harmony.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Recognition as State Festival:** Onam is officially recognized as Kerala’s state festival due to its cultural, historical, and social relevance.
 
• **Economic Impact:** The festival boosts the economy of Kerala through tourism, local markets, and cultural events.
 
• **Tourism Attraction:** Onam attracts tourists globally who come to experience Kerala’s traditional art forms, feasts, and celebrations.
 
• **Government Involvement:** The Kerala government organizes events and competitions during Onam, including fairs, cultural programs, and exhibitions.
 
• **Global Observance:** Malayali communities worldwide celebrate Onam, showcasing Kerala’s cultural heritage on a global stage.
